editorial_notes: Prayer times change by date and location. On-air Salah windows are labeled as local prayer windows and must be seasonally adjusted for the service location.
A broadcast does not itself constitute a Minyan or congregational prayer. Community and rabbinic guidance determines religious participation.
Torah refers to the Five Books of Moses; Tanakh refers to the broader Hebrew Bible. Label Jewish programming by its own community or movement when relevant.
Use Quran, mosque or masjid, and Imam accurately. Islamic observances follow the Hijri calendar and require annually verified dates.
